description: The order of tries, every busy answer, a throw, no room.

cases.description: the first place gives a machine
busy zone tries the next zone
busy type skips the type's other zones
busy market tries the entry's next market
busy account tries the next entry
a throw stops the failover and reaches the app
every place busy gives null, after one try each
zones are tried by name, whatever order places gives
types are tried in the entry's order
a type places does not return is skipped without a try
a created machine carries the rig tags
a kind's own tags are on the machine, with the rig tags
a later entry's places is not called while an earlier one gives a machine
